# Caraka Samhita

Take clean, sprouted <term>masha</term> <gloss>black gram</gloss> beans, sweet and mixed with the pulp of <term>kapittha</term> <gloss>wood-apple</gloss> fruit. Place these into a generous amount of buffalo meat broth prepared with yogurt and pomegranate. Season the mixture with coriander, cumin, and dry ginger. When this savory broth is drunk or eaten, it produces an inexhaustible supply of <term>shukra</term> <gloss>semen and reproductive essence</gloss>.
-> This is the Aphrodisiac Buffalo Broth. <-

One who eats fresh fish or fried <term>shaphari</term> <gloss>small silvery carp</gloss> in hot <term>sarpi</term> <gloss>clarified butter or ghee</gloss> will not experience exhaustion with women.
-> This is the Aphrodisiac Fish Fried in Ghee. <-

One who desires offspring should use <term>rohita</term> <gloss>red-scaled carp</gloss> fish fried in ghee and cooked in goat meat broth along with sour fruits. These should be eaten while also drinking the prepared broth.
-> This is the Formula for Achieving Conception. <-

Take minced fish meat and mix it with <term>hingu</term> <gloss>asafoetida</gloss>, <term>saindhava</term> <gloss>rock salt</gloss>, and coriander. Combine this with wheat flour and cook as <term>pupalika</term> <gloss>pancakes or small fried cakes</gloss> in ghee.
Alternatively, cook fish in buffalo broth that is rich in fats, sour, and salty. Once the juices are absorbed, crush the fish and add black pepper, cumin, coriander, a little asafoetida, and fresh ghee. This mixture should be used as a filling for pancakes made of black gram flour.
These two pancake formulas are aphrodisiacs and strengtheners of the body. They grant excitement, good fortune, and nourishment, and they are excellent for increasing reproductive essence.
-> These are the two Aphrodisiac Pancake Formulas. <-

---
Black gram, <term>atmagupta</term> <gloss>cowhage or Mucuna pruriens</gloss>, wheat, and the flour of <term>shali</term> <gloss>winter rice</gloss> and <term>shashtika</term> <gloss>sixty-day rice</gloss>...

<summary>This page details specific Ayurvedic culinary recipes including broths, fried fish, and stuffed pancakes designed to act as aphrodisiacs and promote fertility. The preparations emphasize the use of black gram, ghee, buffalo broth, and specific spices to enhance reproductive health.</summary>
